reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 36 original verb exercises: checked complete German sentences, inflections, reflexive/separable constructions, all distractors, unique offered answers, bilingual feedback and distinct contexts. Reviewed pinned meanings/CEFR labels and existing production plus initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion draft objectives; no identical verb-specific target mapped. Two regional/level-sensitive seeds deferred honestly. Source gloss corrections recorded; independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending. Second editorial pass removed redundant netzwerken phrasing and corrected the participle zusammengenäht (one word).
